# Jitter RNG health test vector: lag predictor test, intermittent.
#
# The deltas repeat a cycle of four distinct values, so the predictor looking
# four measurements back is always right. Nothing is stuck - no delta, second
# or third derivative is zero - so the RCT stays quiet, and each symbol takes
# only a quarter of an APT window, so the APT does too. The lag predictor is
# the only test that fires.
#
# 140 measurements: past the local cutoff of 111 at osr 3 and short of the permanent cutoff of 177.
#
# One decimal time stamp per line. Replay with:
#   tests/health/health --replay <this file>
